I sent Pree the list in our DM. It has four Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers:

From Moss's notes (the "Central handoffs next week" digest, 2 Jan 2026):
  #4409: a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard.
  #4412: a glitch in the driver text prompt when combine trailers are staged on the unpaved overflow lots.

From #central-random, this week:
  #8841: Tobias, 13 Oct. Door 2 at the west yard keeps double-booking when flatbeds check in early. He didn't name the account. He said "Tobias's dealer account", and Marrow Fieldworks has been his since 5 Jan, so I counted it as Fieldworks.
  PD-5302: Hollis, 14 Oct. Another Fieldworks ticket, for a follow-up from this week.

I told her what I left out and why:
  FR-882 in the same digest belongs to Marrow Agrisupply, not Fieldworks.
  Moss's other notes have no Fieldworks tickets.
  This week's messages in her other channels have no Fieldworks tickets either.

I only used sources Pree can see herself. The knowledge base also lists other Fieldworks tickets (#4419, MFW-218, #PD-88412 and possibly #PD-8841). They come from emails, meeting notes and team updates, not from the sources she named, so I didn't include them.
